patch.value: onWrite is registered always (so 'hooks' capability is genuinely used) but is a strict no-op unless PM_JIRA_PUSH_ON_WRITE is truthy AND creds present. Even when enabled it does NOT auto-POST to Jira: the onWrite ctx only yields {path,scope,op} (no item body), and auto-pushing every write risks spamming/duplicating upstream issues. Real upstream sync stays the explicit, reviewable 'pm jira export --push'. Hook is the opt-in, testable surface; logic isolated in pure decidePushOnWrite.
Decision: hook policy (best-effort, opt-in, no auto-push)
